Your Job

Molex is seeking a motivated Software Engineer, Developer Productivity (AI Agents), to join our Optical Systems Business Unit in Fremont, California. In this role you will contribute to AI-assisted firmware development for next-generation optical transceivers — including OSFP and QSFP-DD form factors at 800G and 1.6T — serving datacenter and telecom markets. The ideal candidate brings strong fundamentals in Python and software testing, and hands-on experience with AI coding agents. You will collaborate with firmware, hardware and test engineering teams across multiple time zones to build tools that help engineers use AI coding agents with confidence.

This position is open to recent graduates and early-career professionals. You will learn through hands-on projects, code reviews and mentoring from your manager and experienced firmware engineers.

Our Team

Molex brings a rich heritage in the optical industry, with the highest performing and field-proven solutions spanning components, modules and integrated line-cards. Our comprehensive optical, mechanical, electrical and software design capabilities allow us to serve the high-density, high-bandwidth and flexible networking needs of hyperscale datacenter, datacom and telecom customers. Continuous innovation in component integration, miniaturization and manufacturing automation keeps our products at the leading edge of optical networking.

What You Will Do

Build, test and maintain AI development tooling, such as agent rules, skills, hooks and CI checks
Develop and test Python and shell scripts that automate builds, code review steps and release checks
Add evaluation cases drawn from real defects and planted bugs, and run them to check rule, workflow and model changes
Extend static analysis and CI checks that enforce firmware coding and safety rules
Implement the team's guardrails and review standards for AI-generated changes, including traceability to the engineers who approve them
Troubleshoot and resolve tooling issues reported by firmware engineers in Windows and Linux development environments
Compare AI models and tools on quality, speed and cost, and summarize the results
Collect and analyze data on tooling use and failures, and report findings to the team
Document tools and workflows, and help firmware engineers adopt them
Learn how firmware is developed, reviewed and released, and how it controls optical hardware

Who You Are (Basic Qualifications)

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related field
Experience programming in Python, through coursework, internships, projects or professional work
Knowledge of data structures, algorithms and software testing
Familiarity with shell scripting in bash or PowerShell on Linux and Windows
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents, including reviewing and testing the code they generate
Experience with Git version control, such as branching and merging

What Will Put You Ahead

Experience with C, embedded systems or microcontroller programming
Experience with compilers, parsers or static analysis tools, such as libclang or tree-sitter
Experience extending AI agents with custom tools, MCP servers or agent SDKs
Internship, co-op or work experience in developer tools, build systems or CI/CD pipelines
Background in statistics, experiment design or machine learning evaluation
Background in optics, photonics or digital communications

For this role, we anticipate paying $110,000 - $120,000 per year. This role is eligible for variable pay, issued as a monetary bonus or in another form.

At Koch companies, we are entrepreneurs. This means we openly challenge the status quo, find new ways to create value and get rewarded for our individual contributions. Any compensation range provided for a role is an estimate determined by available market data. The actual amount may be higher or lower than the range provided considering each candidate's knowledge, skills, abilities, and geographic location. If you have questions, please speak to your recruiter about the flexibility and detail of our compensation philosophy.

Hiring Philosophy

All Koch companies value diversity of thought, perspectives, aptitudes, experiences, and backgrounds. We are Military Ready and Second Chance employers. Learn more about our hiring philosophy here.

Who We Are

As a Koch company, Molex is a leading supplier of connectors and interconnect components, driving innovation in electronics and supporting industries from automotive to health care and consumer to data communications. The thousands of innovators who work for Molex have made us a global electronics leader. Our experienced people, groundbreaking products and leading-edge technologies help us deliver a wider array of solutions to more markets than ever before.At Koch, employees are empowered to do what they do best to make life better. Learn how our business philosophy helps employees unleash their potential while creating value for themselves and the company.

Our Benefits

Our goal is for each employee, and their families, to live fulfilling and healthy lives. We provide essential resources and support to build and maintain physical, financial, and emotional strength - focusing on overall wellbeing so you can focus on what matters most. Our benefits plan includes - medical, dental, vision, flexible spending and health savings accounts, life insurance, ADD, disability, retirement, paid vacation/time off, educational assistance, and may also include infertility assistance, paid parental leave and adoption assistance. Specific eligibility criteria is set by the applicable Summary Plan Description, policy or guideline and benefits may vary by geographic region. If you have questions on what benefits apply to you, please speak to your recruiter.

Additionally, everyone has individual work and personal needs. We seek to enable the best work environment that helps you and the business work together to produce superior results.

Equal Opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status. Except where prohibited by state law, some offers of employment are conditioned upon successfully passing a drug test.
